decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to continuously cast spells from the graveyard, enabling explosive combo plays. The deck includes cheap spells to fuel this strategy, as well as disruptive cards like Spell Pierce and Remand to protect the combo. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide additional aggression and card advantage. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help dig for combo pieces while also filling the graveyard. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and creatures while controlling the battlefield.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent while utilizing efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell to control the board and protect your threats. By including cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration, the deck can generate card advantage and ensure a steady stream of threats. With a mixture of early aggression and disruption, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent quickly and maintain control of the game throughout.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to put pressure on the opponent quickly. By combining efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Terminate with hand disruption like Thoughtseize, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to close out the game. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Dauthi Voidwalker provide additional disruption and utility, allowing the deck to adapt to different matchups and strategies.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Underworld Breach and Mishra's Bauble to generate a loop of powerful card advantage and mana to fuel aggressive plays with Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. Teferi, Time Raveler disrupts the opponent's plans while cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide removal and reach. Ledger Shredder is used to mill the opponent out once the combo is assembled, making it a versatile win condition. The mana base is streamlined for consistency, with versatile lands like Fiery Islet and Mystic Dispute to support the game plan.

The deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy, utilizing cards that provide card advantage, disruption, and efficient threats to overwhelm the opponent. By combining efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat with versatile threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Counterspells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell provide additional protection, while cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help generate card advantage and smooth out draws. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility.

The key concept of this deck is to use the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant) to create a large amount of mana, which is then used to play powerful control cards like Ensnaring Bridge, Karn the Great Creator, and Mystic Forge. The deck also utilizes artifacts like Serum Powder, Mishra's Bauble, and Walking Ballista to manipulate the game state and gain card advantage. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's strategy by preventing them from attacking with Ensnaring Bridge, and to win the game through card advantage and powerful artifact synergy.

The key strategy of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively control the board with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also utilizes disruptive counter spells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell to protect its creatures and prevent the opponent from stabilizing. Card selection and advantage is gained through Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration, allowing the deck to maintain pressure and close out games swiftly.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game through the use of UrzaTron, a combination of Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Mine, and Urza's Tower, which allows the player to generate a large amount of colorless mana. This allows for the casting of powerful cards such as Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also utilizes cards like Chromatic Sphere, Chromatic Star, and Expedition Map to search for and manipulate the Tron lands. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana acceleration and versatility.

The deck revolves around using cascade spells like Violent Outburst to cheat creatures with high mana costs like Curator of Mysteries and Archfiend of Ifnir into play for free. These creatures can then be used to control the board or finish off the opponent. The key strategy is to fill the graveyard with creatures using Grief and Architects of Will, then cast Living End to bring them all back at once. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Negation and Subtlety to protect the combo.

This deck aims to control the board through powerful removal spells and disrupt the opponent's game plan while assembling the UrzaTron lands to generate massive amounts of mana. By playing powerful threats like Karn Liberated, Wurmcoil Engine, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, the deck looks to dominate the late game and overwhelm the opponent with its high-impact cards. The inclusion of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Walking Ballista provide additional utility and flexibility to deal with a variety of matchups, making it a versatile and resilient control deck in the Modern format.

This deck revolves around the strategy of using Indomitable Creativity to exchange tokens created by Dwarven Mine for powerful and game-winning creatures like Archon of Cruelty. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide control and recursion, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Big Score offer additional combo potential. Leyline Binding helps to protect the combo pieces, while cards like Spell Pierce and Lightning Bolt offer disruption and removal. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently, overwhelming the opponent with its creativity and synergy.

The deck focuses on utilizing creature toolbox cards like Wall of Roots, Strangleroot Geist, and Young Wolf to generate value and control the board while actively searching for combo pieces with cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. The main win condition revolves around Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, and utilizing its abilities to generate card advantage and ultimately drain the opponent's life total with a Blood Artist on the field. The deck also includes cards like Endurance and Grist, the Hunger Tide for graveyard hate and token generation, respectively, to further solidify its board presence and control.

The deck focuses on a fast-paced, aggressive strategy utilizing low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to apply pressure early on. It also includes disruptive elements such as Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also features removal spells like Terminate and Kolaghan's Command to deal with threats on the opponent's side of the board. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect and recur key creatures, allowing for sustained aggression. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and disruption.

This deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply early pressure on the opponent. It also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate to control the board and keep the opponent on the back foot. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and removal spells, while also utilizing cards like Grief and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Feign Death add additional versatility and disruption to the deck's strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with cascade effects to put pressure on the opponent and overwhelm them with powerful creatures and control options. By utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, the deck can quickly cascade into cards like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent to generate a strong board presence. The inclusion of counter spells like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation helps protect the deck's strategy while cards like Brazen Borrower provide additional tempo plays. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and disruptive to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive red spells and creatures, consistently dealing damage and putting pressure on them to keep up. With a low mana curve and efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Spike, paired with creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. The inclusion of cards like Boros Charm and Eidolon of the Great Revel further adds to the aggressive nature of the deck, making it a formidable force in one-on-one Modern matches.
